advice: If the submission wizard shows validation errors you already fixed, change the MCP URL/tool form to force a refresh — stale errors were a known bug (fixed Apr 2026, may recur).
detail: OpenAI changelog roundup Apr 2026: fixed wizard holding stale validation errors after MCP URL/tool changes.

advice: Assume review takes weeks with no SLA — submit domains first and let print/trades queue behind the learnings, not in parallel.
detail: Forum threads (Jan–Jul 2026) show highly variable timelines; launch-period approvals were partners-only until January. Sequencing de-risks: one live approval teaches more than three pending submissions.

advice: Backend-only optimizations with an unchanged MCP surface may not need resubmission — but any tool/schema/widget change does.
detail: Open community question (May 2026, unresolved in thread): confirm per-case. Design implication: keep the MCP contract stable and iterate behind adapters — exactly the plan.md rule.

advice: Refresh the developer-mode connector after every MCP tools/metadata change, or you will chase ghosts.
detail: Top practitioner tip; stale tool lists during iteration are routinely mistaken for model/routing failures. Same discipline applies to Scan Tools rescans at submission.

advice: Avoid iframes/frame_domains unless essential, and version widget resource URIs — both add review friction and cache pain.
detail: frame_domains triggers a sensitive review path (since relaxed for repeat approvals, but still). Unversioned widget URIs cause stale-UI ghost bugs. Domains V1 needs no UI at all.

advice: Return only the data the task needs, and say so in the privacy policy — over-collection is a rejection vector.
detail: Checklist item from practitioners; aligns with official minimum-necessary policy. Our DomainCheck/Quote shapes already exclude PII.

advice: Keep the full submission packet (assets, descriptions, test cases) under version control — rejections have wiped dashboard data, forcing from-scratch resubmits.
detail: Multiple devs report rejected apps losing all data (fix claimed deployed; don't rely on it). The chatgpt-app-submission.json skill output should be generated and committed per app.

advice: Assume ~20-day update reviews against moving requirements — keep tool schemas frozen and iterate behind adapters.
detail: philippexe: update rejected twice because SDK/tool requirements changed mid-queue. This is the operational reason for plan.md's stable-canonical-schema rule and decoupled deploy.

advice: Supply working test-user credentials requiring no MFA, email verification, or setup — missing/failing creds is the most common first rejection.
detail: Xpoz rejected first on missing credentials, second on descriptions. Appeal via reply-to-rejection-email with Case ID; OAuth failures appeal fastest through openai-review@openai.com per Casey.

advice: Ship reviewer-session telemetry with every submission — without it you argue with rejections blindly.
detail: hunter_h assumed a reviewer was wrong; telemetry proved the reviewer hit a real bug; fixed and approved. Instrument connect/list/select/args/execute/render/error/theme/client/latency/result. mcp-signal's model-invisible tool-call pattern shows how to exfiltrate widget events past CSP with credentials server-side.

advice: Pre-check the three deterministic rejection classics: blank-data test case, dark/light theme support, zero dev links in widget CSP.
detail: Tushar Dhar: fixed exactly these three and went from rejected to approved. All machine-checkable — encode in the submission gate, not memory.

advice: Tool names, signatures and descriptions lock at publication — any change needs re-review, so freeze schemas early.
detail: Official submission flow. This is the hard constraint behind stable canonical schemas and backend-only iteration. One version per app in review at a time; EU-residency projects cannot submit at all.

advice: Keep versionless MCP endpoints stable forever; submitted tools/list is snapshotted while calls hit the live backend.
detail: Per OpenAI forum guidance on update submissions. Never move MCP infra for branding reasons — decouple display name from hostname on day one. Our manifest already separates capability page from mcp path.

advice: Treat tool metadata brevity as a submission constraint: token-limit errors are now surfaced at submission time.
detail: April submission update. Our description-length gate (40–600 chars) plus density gates enforce this mechanically; every annotation needs its explicit explanation.

advice: Ship V1 tools with zero dependence on update-model-context or widget state — ChatGPT is regressing on exactly those paths.
detail: Reports: acknowledged-but-stale context, silently dropped updates, vanishing app selection, blank Android widgets, inconsistent Android auth. One prompt → one tool → deterministic structured result until the paths stabilize; track in compatibility.json.

advice: Budget a paid ChatGPT account for testing — developer-mode app testing has required one.
detail: MCPJam thread: builder could only test with a paid account. Factor into onboarding costs, not just submission.
